card.name: Linking words in dosage ranges
card.fires_on: Small linking words (of, or, to, from, than, based, for) in dosing instructions, right after a dose, range or interval and just before the next number or condition.

modes.label: Range linkers
modes.description: Of, or, to or from joining two doses in a range or choice of strengths.
modes.example: Initiate treatment with Levorphanol Tartrate Tablets in a dosing range<< of>> 1 to 2 mg every

modes.label: Other dosing links
modes.description: Words such as based, than or for that introduce a condition or interval in the dosage section.
modes.example: 2 DOSAGE AND ADMINISTRATION Select patients for treatment with RETEVMO<< based>> on the presence of a RET gene fusion
